title: Weighing Concessions: Register and Emphasis
goal: Contrast *a pesar de*, *aun cuando* and the concessive future by register and fact vs possibility

items: I can use *pese a* and *a pesar de* cleanly with nouns, infinitives and full clauses.
I can use *aun cuando* with the indicative or subjunctive for formal, emphatic concession.
I can shift between written concessions and the spoken concessive future using cost and value vocabulary.
